description_excerpt: Job Description Production Operation & Technical Execution • Set up, adjust, and operate multi-color offset printing presses and auxiliary equipment according to job specifications. • Monitor print quality continuously (color consistency, registration, ink-water balance) to meet strict client standards for label products. • Perform routine preventive maintenance and troubleshoot mechanical or operational issues on the press to minimize downtime.
